beats.text: Fine-tuning 175 billion parameters for every niche task is an economic death sentence for your GPU cluster.

beats.text: The bottleneck isn't the math; it's the sheer weight update volume forcing massive, redundant VRAM consumption on every deployment.
beats.visual_focus: A bottleneck funnel choking memory bandwidth while trying to update giant weight tensors.

visual_blueprint.title: VRAM SATURATION BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Weight update volume exceeding memory bus capacity

motif_params.title: VRAM SATURATION BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Weight update volume exceeding memory bus capacity

beats.text: LoRA bypasses this by freezing the base model and injecting tiny, rank-decomposition matrices into each layer's weights.
beats.visual_focus: Two small matrices A and B collapsing the weight update rank, then injecting into the frozen block.
